theorem_title: Exact first and second odd-step valuation congruences
natural_language_statement:
For every $q\in\mathbb N$,

$$
3(16q+11)+1\equiv2\pmod4,\qquad3(24q+17)+1\equiv4\pmod8.
$$

These congruences certify exact powers of two with exponents 1 and 2 in the two odd updates.
formal_statement:
theorem BlindCollatz.AlternatingGrowth.odd_exponents_one_two (q : Nat) :
    (3 * (16 * q + 11) + 1) % 4 = 2 ∧
    (3 * (24 * q + 17) + 1) % 8 = 4 := by sorry
